info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Mortgage Loans Payoffs-v2-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loan Payoff Retrieval API enables users to access detailed information regarding payoff amounts for mortgage loans. This API provides a streamlined way for financial institutions, service providers, and developers to retrieve the most current payoff data associated with specific loan accounts. Typical consumers include loan servicers and customer service representatives who require accurate payoff information to assist clients effectively. By using this API, stakeholders can ensure timely and accurate loan payoff processing, enhancing customer satisfaction.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve details regarding the payoff of a specific loan, including the total amount due and other related information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a payoff operation for a loan. It should contain all necessary details as defined in the associated schema to successfully process the request.
